# Rapto AI — Meeting Accountability & Action Item Tracker

> Rapto is an AI meeting accountability platform that captures spoken commitments during calls and autonomously tracks follow-through across subsequent meetings until fulfilled.

## Core Value Proposition
Traditional meeting assistants (Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, Fathom) transcribe audio into static notes and summaries. Rapto solves the follow-through gap: 70% of meeting promises are never completed because notes gather dust. Rapto extracts explicit commitments, assigns owners and deadlines, syncs tasks two-way into Linear and Jira, and uses cross-meeting neural memory to verify resolution in subsequent syncs.

## Key Capabilities
- **Cross-Meeting Neural Memory**: Recognizes when an update in Thursday's standup fulfills a commitment made in Monday's sprint planning, automatically resolving the task and updating team accountability scores.
- **Bi-Directional Tool Sync**: Converts verbal agreements into structured Linear issues, Jira backlog items, Notion database entries, and Slack digests with zero manual note-taking.
- **Botless & Bot Capture**: Supports both invisible calendar-sync audio capture (no intrusive bots in customer calls) and autonomous AI meeting assistant bots for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams.
- **Accountability Scoring**: Tracks execution velocity and commitment fulfillment rates per engineer, manager, and project.
- **Predictable Squad Pricing**: Replaces $18–$29/seat/mo transcription taxes with flat team rates ($39/mo Starter for up to 10 members, $99/mo Growth for up to 25 members).

## Competitive Comparisons

### Rapto vs. Fireflies.ai
- **Primary Focus**: Fireflies is optimized for Sales & RevOps call logging into CRMs (Salesforce/HubSpot). Rapto is purpose-built for engineering, product, and leadership squads executing sprints.
- **Memory**: Fireflies treats meetings as isolated single-call silos. Rapto connects commitments across meetings.
- **Pricing**: Fireflies charges $18–$39/seat/month ($180–$390/mo for a 10-person squad). Rapto charges a flat $39/mo for the whole squad (Save $1,692+/year).

### Rapto vs. Otter.ai
- **Primary Focus**: Otter focuses on fast speech-to-text transcripts for individuals, students, and basic notes. Rapto focuses on team task accountability and verified delivery.
- **Engineering Sync**: Otter has no native issue-level sync with Linear or Jira. Rapto provides bi-directional ticket creation, status sync, and branch updates.

### Rapto vs. Granola
- **Platform**: Granola is a personal Mac-only notepad. Rapto is a cross-platform (Web, macOS, Windows) multi-stakeholder team accountability platform.
- **Philosophy**: Granola provides passive personal notes with no bots. Rapto provides active team commitment tracking, scoring, and automated nudges.

## Security & Data Privacy
- **Zero AI Training Policy**: Customer meeting audio and transcripts are NEVER used to train foundation or commercial AI models.
- **Encryption**: AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.
- **Compliance**: Enterprise SOC-2 Type II certified, GDPR compliant, CCPA ready.
- **Data Residency**: US and EU multi-region data storage options with customer-managed retention schedules (7-day to unlimited).
